{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to be safe
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm we are using all patients, not just those with highest sample_seq
# Check how many unique patients and sample_seq per patient
patient_sample_count = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].count().value_counts()
print('Number of patients with multiple samples:', patient_sample_count.get(2, 0))

# The data has 848 rows and 848 patients (from patient_id), so each patient has exactly one row
# So we don't need to deduplicate by sample_seq
print('Total number of unique patients:', df['patient_id'].nunique())
print('Total number of rows:', len(df))"}
